description: Run and identity injection, the per-sitting turn limit and the sitting span for frank-exchange-of-views; why each is wired this way is in hooks/README.md.

hooks.command: B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/feov-pretooluse"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook PreToolUse; fi; echo 'frank-exchange-of-views: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2

B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/feov-subagentstart"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SubagentStart; fi; echo 'frank-exchange-of-views: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2

B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/feov-subagentstop"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B"; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SubagentStop; fi; echo 'frank-exchange-of-views: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2
